node.title: EF descended pole-free cycle classification payload
node.statement: Classify every B-defined pole-free horizontal cycle in the extension-fiber incidence, after full-orbit descent, as base-descended, proper-subfield/tower-confined, or noncontainment-degenerate. This is reduced to the proved descended-cycle inventory soundness rule plus the remaining actual EF descended-cycle inventory payload.
node.attack_surface: assembly from the inventory soundness rule and actual EF extension-fiber arithmetic and noncontainment classification for descended pole-free cycles
node.falsifier: a B-defined pole-free cycle that is not base-descended, not tower-confined, and survives the noncontainment gate
